name: mangabaka-url-finder
description: Find matching provider URLs for MangaBaka and search MangaBaka from supported provider pages.

scripts.build: node scripts/update-build-info.mjs && npm run clean && tsc
scripts.build:all: npm run build:complete && npm run build:google && npm run build:firefox
scripts.package:all: npm run package:complete && npm run package:google && npm run package:firefox
